# Gym Journal — Sets & Reps Log for iPhone and iPad

> A lifting journal, not a training plan. Log every set by hand or by voice, catch every personal record, and watch each lift trend — local-first, no account, no ads.

Gym Journal is a native iOS and iPadOS app for lifters who follow their own programme: it does
not build routines, prescribe splits or choose your weights. It records what you actually lifted
and shows whether it is going up. All data lives on the device; there is no signup, no analytics
and no advertising. iCloud sync is optional and free.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://pcristo.dev/gym-journal-website/): what it is, logging, progress, free vs Pro, FAQ

## Features

- **Logging** — a set by hand, or by voice: hold the button, say "bench press 60 kilos for 8", and
  the set is saved. Voice transcription runs on-device and the audio is never stored.
- **Exercise library** — 90 movements across six body parts (chest, back, legs, arms, shoulders,
  core), plus custom movements of your own.
- **Personal records** — caught automatically against your best estimated 1RM, and celebrated.
- **Charts** — load over time per movement, top set and estimated 1RM, sessions logged, volume, and
  a four-week comparison.
- **Weekly streak** — counts the weeks you trained, not the days you missed.
- **Goals** — a weight you are chasing, or a target number of total reps, measured from logged sets.
- **Levels and Lifty** — an XP level and a mascot that gains gear as you train.
- **Plate maths** — what to load on the bar; kg or lb, with warm-up sets marked.
- **Reminders** — at most two a day, and they back off if you stop answering.
- **iCloud sync** — through the user's own private iCloud; free on every plan.
- **Languages** — English, Spanish and French, including voice commands.

## Pricing

- **Free for ever** — unlimited logging, full history, weekly streak, personal records, plate maths,
  the one-month chart range, iCloud sync, and two custom movements.
- **Pro** — the longer chart ranges (three months, six months, all time) and unlimited custom
  movements. Monthly, yearly, or a one-time lifetime unlock; a 3-day free trial on monthly and
  yearly. Prices are set by the App Store per region.

## Privacy

No account, no signup, no analytics, no ads, no tracking, no third parties. The app does not collect
any information when it is downloaded and used. Data is stored on the device; uninstalling the app
is a complete opt-out. Nothing leaves the phone except an optional sync to the user's own private
iCloud. Purchases are handled by Apple.
